name: Intoxication
overview: Scripture warns against intoxication as a source of deception and moral downfall, highlighting that wine and strong drink can mock and rage, leading to unwise decisions (Proverbs 20:1). Believers are called to live honorably and avoid behaviors such as drunkenness, which is associated with sinful acts that exclude one from inheriting God's kingdom (Romans 13:13; Galatians 5:21). Instead of being controlled by excess wine, Christians are exhorted to be filled with the Spirit, embracing a life marked by self-control and holiness (Ephesians 5:18).
